newsitem.title: USA: CPI confusion may limit new US bond issue - Rubin.
newsitem.headline: CPI confusion may limit new US bond issue - Rubin.

text.p: The confusion over the Consumer Price Index (CPI) may limit the size of the Treasury Department's first issue of index-linked debt, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Thursday.
"I suspect the initial issue will be relatively small," he told a forum sponsored by the John F. Kennedy School.
"The Boskin report might create confusion around the CPI and may tend to have a somewhat deterring impact in terms of the initial issuance," he added.
A Congressionally appointed commission headed by Michael Boskin last week said that the CPI overstates inflation by 1.1 percentage points per year.
The Treasury plans to issue its first index-linked debt next month, a 10-year note tied to movements in the CPI.
